course_id: Lịch sử Đảng Cộng Sản Việt Nam
title: History of the Communist Party of Vietnam

skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Analyze historical events and their impact on Vietnamese society.
Understand the political theories and ideologies of the Communist Party of Vietnam.
Develop critical thinking skills by analyzing complex political and historical issues.
Apply research methodologies to study the history of the Communist Party of Vietnam.
Improve communication skills through class participation and presentations.
